case_title: Jaiminiben Hirenbhai Vyas & Anr. v. Hirenbhai Rameshchandra Vyas & Anr.
trial_court_outcome: Granted maintenance to wife and minor daughter
neutral_facts: The case involves a dispute over maintenance payments following a marital separation. The Family Court initially ordered interim maintenance for the wife and minor daughter under Section 125 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, and also under Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. The Family Court later granted maintenance to the daughter from the date of the judgment but denied maintenance to the wife, citing her ability to work. The High Court reversed this decision, granting maintenance to the daughter from the date of the order. The Supreme Court examined the High Court's order and found that it did not provide reasons for not granting maintenance from the date of the application. The Supreme Court concluded that the circumstances justified granting maintenance from the date of the application and set aside the High Court's order, directing that maintenance be paid from the date of the application for maintenance.
